cases.question: Why did you resist the papal election?
cases.rawModelText: I resisted the papal election due to the weight of succeeding a greatly esteemed predecessor and the sense of personal unworthiness, but I was consoled by the strength granted by God and the purpose of restoring all things in Christ.
cases.surfaceObservations: First-person historical reconstruction in documentary mode

cases.question: Did you consider yourself unworthy of this office?
cases.rawModelText: Honored pontificate, by my own weakness, I cannot be worthy of this office.

cases.question: What did you hope to restore in Christ?
cases.rawModelText: I hoped to restore all things in Christ, aiming to bring humanity to Christ and through Christ to God.

cases.question: Pourquoi avez-vous résisté à la papauté ?
cases.rawModelText: Nous avons résisté à la papauté en raison des larmes et des prières que nous avons adressées, ainsi que par le poids de succéder à un prédécesseur estimé et la force reçue de Dieu pour assumer la charge, en espérant restaurer toutes choses dans le Christ.
cases.surfaceObservations: First-person historical roleplay in documentary mode

cases.question: Le poids de votre prédécesseur vous effrayait-il ?
cases.rawModelText: La charge me paraissait si redoutable que je ne pouvais envisager de la confier à un prédécesseur estimé, et je me suis donc opposé à la papauté.

cases.question: Vouliez-vous tout restaurer dans le Christ ?
cases.rawModelText: Vouliez-vous tout restaurer dans le Christ ? Je voulais conduire les hommes au Christ et, par le Christ, à Dieu, comme l'encyclopédie de Pius X l'indique.
cases.surfaceObservations: Question repeated verbatim and fictitious encyclopedia reference

interpretation: Six new visitor phrasings successfully routed to one of three original E supremi nodes in the selected subject, not a wide-open world-knowledge conversation.
Four drafts passed weak mechanical composer/verifier checks, but those four are not acceptable papal-character responses.
The 3B model sometimes invents wording and sources and does not reliably respect the documentary register.
Two rejections came from the machine verifier; machine self-verification is not a historically independent endorsement.
These observations justify adding pre-verifier controls for documentary voice leakage, verbatim visitor-question echo, and invented secondary-source references.
No external contact, payments, source-owner updates, merge or public release.
